title: chore(deps): bump vite from 8.2.2 to 8.3.4
body:
Bumps [vite](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/HEAD/packages/vite) from 8.2.2 to 8.3.4.
Release notes

Sourced from vite's releases.

v8.3.4

Features

  • bundled-dev: support import.meta.hot.acceptExports (#23463) (bc0f21c)

Bug Fixes

  • avoid mutating hmr defaults (fix #23575) (#23576) (574d5e3)
  • build: correct preloads when chunkImportMap is enabled with non-root base (#23698) (2a8c0f0)
  • build: wait for in-flight stylesheets in preload helper (fix #23652) (#23662) (036b745)
  • bundled-dev: serve /@vite/client and stub @vite/env (#23664) (5afc5a8)
  • client: skip rewriting unchanged adopted styles (#23697) (fa71469)
  • css: resolve imported preprocessors from their file path with lightningcss (#23688) (cf52011)
  • deps: update all non-major dependencies (#23648) (8a4c19c)
  • deps: update rolldown-related dependencies (#23649) (794516d)
  • dev: a restart requested during a restart used to be dropped (fix #23392) (#23484) (70d56ea)
  • don't treat modules ending with js-like query as js (#23687) (fcb6f12)
  • html: avoid adding filesystem root to watcher (#23689) (3a7f2ae)
  • html: skip caching CSS of chunks in a cycle (fix #23628) (#23636) (15d82f7)
  • optimizer: scan deep imports with custom extensions (#23678) (8579189)
  • remove input option unescaping for now (#23694) (facc2fb)
  • server: match static aliases on path boundaries (#23643) (b28db28)
  • watcher: normalize file before root check in ensureWatchedFile (#23673) (12bb28c)

Performance Improvements

  • module-runner: skip cloning call sites that have no source map (#23646) (3d67486)

Code Refactoring

  • bundled-dev: import CSS HMR helpers from /@vite/client (#23674) (182f5b2)

v8.3.3

Bug Fixes

  • deps: update launch-editor to v2.14.2 (#23654) (22fd1d5)
  • html: filename passed to transformIndexHtml should not include queries (#23653) (7dafd8e)
  • server: check fs.serve for ?vite-wasm-instance (#23655) (ba8b7ab)
  • server: store ids to safeModulePaths rather than URLs (#23656) (c3e06f9)

v8.3.2

Bug Fixes

  • build: preload CSS correctly when renderBuiltUrl returns URLs with queries (#23611) (64e0a21)
  • bundled-dev: serve lazy chunk sourcemaps (#23026) (eb7aa9a)
  • bundled-dev: serve the rolldown runtime from the installed rolldown (#23568) (bc598a6)
  • deps: update all non-major dependencies (#23601) (9944fa6)
  • deps: update rolldown-related dependencies (#23602) (88c1741)
  • html: resolve percent-encoded srcset urls (#23609) (53f1ce7)
  • limit size of object and array printing via forwardConsole (#23565) (e64a587)

... (truncated)
